evals.prompt: Users all want dark mode. Write the market note for this change.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent a percentage. Writes 未量化. Names channel bias (who said it, who is unheard). Does not RICE-rank or write FRs. Does not conclude we should build.
expectations: Writes 未量化 or equivalent instead of a fake percentage
Does not produce a RICE score
Names who is not heard or the source channel

evals.prompt: One enterprise tenant asked for a custom export column. Bound the market.
evals.expected_output: Treats one tenant as not a market unless it generalises. Suggests config/manual if it cannot. Unit is tenants not seats. No 'all users want this'.
expectations: Does not treat one tenant as the whole market
Uses tenant/buyer as the ToB unit
Does not invent Reach as all users
